_note: The words for every evidence state, one place for every page and the map. scripts/evidence.py maps Statement Map's recorded states to these keys; scripts/glyphs.py draws the same states. Statement Map decides each state; these words only name it. Sentence case, plain, no em dashes. A state that is unknown is said to be unknown.

tone.part: finds part of it stated, or a narrower or weaker statement
tone.other: finds a supporting or a different result stated

agreement.unknown: No outside reader has compared a Lean statement with this family's headline.

pairing.candidate-pairing: Candidate pairing: found by the words the two statements share. Nobody has reviewed whether they state the same thing.
pairing.producer-cited-association: The Lean source cites this theorem by its label. Nobody has reviewed whether the two state the same thing.
pairing.producer-declared-binding: The release's manifest binds this declaration to the theorem. Nobody has reviewed whether the two state the same thing.
pairing.unavailable: No paper theorem is paired with this Lean statement.

claim.candidate: Candidate for the theorem the catalogue describes: of the papers' main statements, it shares the most words with OpenAI's description. Nobody has reviewed the choice.
claim.unresolved: No single theorem in the papers has been identified as the one the catalogue describes. These share the most words with it.

scope_context.family-readings: The outside readers judged the family's Lean statements against the family's headline, as a whole.
scope_context.supporting-or-different: The outside readers find that the release's Lean states a supporting or different result, so the theorem it is paired with is shown under its own heading.

reruns.none: No outside group reports re-running this Lean statement at the release's pin.
reruns.one: Re-run and accepted by one outside group at the release's pin: {names}.
reruns.many: Re-run and accepted by {n} outside groups at the release's pin: {names}.

legend.title: How to read a family
legend.papers: Each short line is one of the family's papers. At most four are drawn.
legend.diamond: A diamond: the release has a Lean statement for the family. A second outline behind it: more than one.
legend.halves: Each half of the diamond is one outside reader's finding on whether that Lean states the family's headline result. Left half: {left}. Right half: {right}.
legend.part: Pale: part of it, or a narrower or weaker statement.
legend.other: Open: a supporting or a different result.
legend.thread_candidate: Dashed line: the theorem and the Lean statement were paired by shared words, and nobody has reviewed the pairing.
legend.thread_cited: Solid line: the Lean source cites the theorem, or the release declares the link.
legend.ring: Brick ring around the papers: an outside check of the paper's result by another method, HOL Light or exact computation.
legend.no_lean: No diamond: the release has no Lean statement for this family. The papers can still be read and checked.

sentence.lean_none: no Lean statement in the release

comparison.different-scope-descriptions:agree: The two outside readers agree on how much of the headline the Lean states, and describe it in different terms.
comparison.different-scope-descriptions:disagree: The two outside readers disagree on how much of the headline the Lean states.
comparison.unavailable:unknown: No outside reader has compared a Lean statement with this family's headline.
